/lore - open or close the panel (or press your key; press it over an NPC to read about them)
/lore <question> - ask directly, e.g. /lore why is westfall so poor
/lore ask <question> - ask live answers (the answer appears on your screen)
/lore autoplay - narrations as you arrive and quest dialogue on/off
/lore ctx | export | visits | stats - what Lore Forever sees, for bug reports and playtests
/lore journey - what your character has done so far; /lore sync - save it now (reloads)
/lore key - choose the key that opens the panel; /lore key narrate - a key that plays narration
/lore lang - choose the language (language packs are separate add-ons)
/lore library - every recorded narration, grouped (your starting area first)
/lore listen - read the last answer aloud; /lore narrate - narrate flights on/off
/lore primer - dungeon primer for where you are
/lore report - tell us the last answer was wrong (or click the cross under any answer)
/lore voice - list narration voices; /lore voice <number or name> - switch (auto: default, none: game voice)

When a quest giver's window opens, play the quest's narration, or read the quest text aloud if Read aloud is on. It stops when the window closes.
When several voices have a narration:
When you enter a dungeon, link its primer in chat, and each boss's story once you beat them.
When you enter a zone whose places and people are narrated in a voice pack you don't have, say so once.
When you enter a zone, suggest a question about it in chat.
When you open a book, letter or plaque, read the page aloud with the game's voice if Read aloud is on. Turning the page reads the next one; closing it stops.
When you reach a zone or place with a recorded narration, play it. Never during combat or a flight, and never over something already playing.
